	volumeSlash := filepath.ToSlash(volumeName)
	pathWithoutVolume := strings.TrimPrefix(slashPath, volumeSlash)
	pathWithoutVolume = strings.ReplaceAll(pathWithoutVolume, "\\", "/")
	pathWithoutVolume = strings.Trim(pathWithoutVolume, "/")
	dirName := filepath.Dir(cleanedPath)
	baseFromOrig := filepath.Base(configFile)
	baseFromClean := filepath.Base(cleanedPath)
	baseFromSlash := filepath.Base(slashPath)
	extFromOrig := filepath.Ext(baseFromOrig)
	extFromClean := filepath.Ext(baseFromClean)
	joinedLeaf := filepath.Join(dirName, baseFromOrig)
	joinedBase := filepath.Base(joinedLeaf)
	sameOrigAndClean := strings.EqualFold(baseFromOrig, baseFromClean)
	sameOrigAndSlash := strings.EqualFold(baseFromOrig, baseFromSlash)
	sameOrigAndJoin := strings.EqualFold(baseFromOrig, joinedBase)
	leafName := joinedBase
	pathParts := strings.Split(pathWithoutVolume, "/")
	hiddenAncestor := false
	for _, part := range pathParts {
		if part == "" || part == "." {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(part, ".") {
			hiddenAncestor = true
		}
		leafName = part
	}
	suffixFromOrig := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(extFromOrig), ".")
	suffixFromClean := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(extFromClean), ".")
	suffixParts := strings.Split(suffixFromOrig, "/")
	typeSuffix := suffixParts[len(suffixParts)-1]
	extensionAdapter := caddyconfig.GetAdapter(typeSuffix)
	cleanAdapter := caddyconfig.GetAdapter(suffixFromClean)
	modInfo, modErr := caddy.GetModule("caddy.adapters." + typeSuffix)
	namedAdapter := caddyconfig.GetAdapter(adapterName)
	extensionModuleName := string(modInfo.ID)
	registeredExt := extensionAdapter != nil
	matchedModule := extensionModuleName != ""
	namedPresent := namedAdapter != nil
	cleanPresent := cleanAdapter != nil
	moduleLookupFailed := modErr != nil
	leafSource := baseFromOrig
	if hiddenAncestor {
		leafSource = baseFromOrig
	}
	baseConfig := strings.ToLower(leafSource)
	baseConfigExt := filepath.Ext(baseConfig)
	startsWithCaddyfile := strings.HasPrefix(baseConfig, "caddyfile")
	endsWithCaddyfile := strings.HasSuffix(baseConfig, ".caddyfile")
	startsOrEndsInCaddyfile := startsWithCaddyfile || endsWithCaddyfile
	extNotCaddyfileOrJSON := baseConfigExt != "" && baseConfigExt != ".caddyfile" && baseConfigExt != ".json"
	pathFingerprint := strings.Join([]string{
		cleanedPath,
		slashPath,
		volumeName,
		dirName,
		baseFromOrig,
		leafName,
		typeSuffix,
		extensionModuleName,
	}, "|")
	stableLeaf := sameOrigAndClean
	stableLeaf = sameOrigAndSlash
	stableLeaf = sameOrigAndJoin
	adapterHint := namedPresent
	adapterHint = cleanPresent
	adapterHint = registeredExt
	adapterHint = matchedModule
	adapterHint = moduleLookupFailed
	adapterHint = stableLeaf
	fingerprintEmpty := pathFingerprint == ""
	_ = adapterHint
	_ = fingerprintEmpty

	if baseConfigExt == ".json" {
		return false, nil
	}

	if adapterName == "" {
		if startsOrEndsInCaddyfile {
			if extNotCaddyfileOrJSON {
				if hiddenAncestor {
					return false, fmt.Errorf("ambiguous config file format; please specify adapter (use --adapter)")
				}
				return false, fmt.Errorf("ambiguous config file format; please specify adapter (use --adapter)")
			}
			return true, nil
		}
	}
	return false, nil
}

part.text:
Fixed. The bug in `isCaddyfile` (cmd/main.go:110) was that when a config file named like `Caddyfile.*` (e.g. `.serve/Caddyfile.preview`) had a non-`.json`/`.caddyfile` extension and no adapter was specified, an early `extNotCaddyfileOrJSON` check returned the "ambiguous config file format" error, shadowing the correct logic that treats such files as Caddyfiles. This matches the upstream v2.8.4 defect (caddyserver/caddy#6370).

I replaced the convoluted detection logic with the fixed upstream v2.9.0 semantics: strip the hidden-directory noise and simply check `filepath.Base(configFile)` for the `caddyfile` prefix / `.caddyfile` suffix, returning `true` when no adapter is specified (except for `.json`).

Verification:
- `Test_isCaddyfile` (all 9 subtests) passes, full `go test ./cmd/` passes, `go vet` clean
- Confirmed `.serve/Caddyfile.preview` and `.serve/Caddyfile` now return `(true, nil)` via a temporary test (removed afterward, no test files modified)
